test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In December 2021, who among the following inaugurated the ‘Bharat Darshan Park’ in Delhi, which has replicas of major monuments from across the country created by a group of artists?
solution:
The correct answer is **Amit Shah.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amit Shah**

 
 
• **Amit Anil Chandra Shah** is an **Indian politician currently serving as the Minister of Home Affairs.**
 
• The first **Minister of Co-operation of India**.
 
• He served as the** President of the Bharatiya Janata Party from 2014 to 2020**.
 
• He has also served as **chairman of the National Democratic Alliance since 2014.**
 
 
 
• **Bharat Darshan Park**
 
 
• The **South Delhi Municipal Corporation** has developed a new park, **Bharat Darshan**, in the **Punjabi Bagh area of west Delhi** which has **replicas of 21 famous structures from across the country**.
 
• Almost** 200 artists worked day and night for 22 months** to complete the park.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dharmendra Pradhan **

 
 
• Indian politician serving as the **Minister of Education and Minister of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship in the Government of India**.
 
• He has also been the** Minister of Petroleum & Natural Gas and Minister of Steel.**
 
• He was promoted to **Cabinet Minister on 3 September 2017**.
 
 
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman**
 
 
• Indian economist and politician serving as the** Minister of Finance and Corporate Affairs of India since 2019**.
 
• She is a member of the **Rajya Sabha, the upper house of the Indian Parliament, since 2014.**
 
 
 
• **Smriti Irani**
 
 
• Indian politician and a former television actress and producer.
 
• She is a **Minister in the Union Cabinet of India since May 2019 currently administrating the Ministries of Women and Child Development and Ministry of Minority Affairs.**
